title: Goa's Palolem Named Best Beach In Asia, Sixth Globally, State Government Says
excerpt: Hindustan Times reported the state government saying Palolem was named best in Asia and sixth globally; the beach is in Canacona, South Goa.
body:
• Goa's Palolem Beach has been named the best beach in Asia and ranked sixth globally, the state government said, as reported by Hindustan Times.
  • The New Indian Express carried the same headline, describing Palolem as Asia's best in a global list of the top 25 beaches.
  • Palolem is a crescent-shaped beach about 1.61 km long in Canacona, South Goa, about 40 minutes from Margao, according to Wikipedia.
  • For diaspora travellers planning a Goa trip, Palolem's Tripadvisor page lists it as a Travellers' Choice Best of the Best winner for 2026, rated 4.5 by reviewers.

Palolem Beach in South Goa has been named the best beach in Asia and ranked sixth globally, the Goa state government said, according to a Hindustan Times report carrying that announcement.

The New Indian Express carried the same development under the headline that Goa's Palolem Beach is Asia's best and ranks sixth in a global list of the top 25 beaches. The reports available for this story do not name, in the text that could be read, the organisation behind the ranking, so this article attributes the claim as it was reported: a statement by the state government, reported by both publications on November 8, 2026.

Separately, Palolem's Tripadvisor page, which was read for this article, lists the beach as a Travellers' Choice Best of the Best winner for 2026, describes it as one of the area's most picturesque beaches, and shows a rating of 4.5 from reviewers. That listing is presented here as traveller information, not as confirmation of the Asia and global positions in the government statement.

Where Palolem is

Palolem Beach is situated in Canacona in southern Goa, according to Wikipedia. It is about one mile, approximately 1.61 km, long and is crescent-shaped, so the entire beach can be viewed from either end. Both ends consist of rocks jutting out into the sea.

Wikipedia says the beach is largely unspoiled and is inhabited by both local fishermen and foreign tourists, who live in shacks along the shore or in the main village itself. It adds that the depth of the sea increases gradually, being shallowest at the northern end, making it suitable for average swimmers, and that currents are not fast.

The beach is within 2.5 kilometres of the market town of Chaudi in South Goa, and about 40 minutes from Margao, the district headquarters of South Goa, according to Wikipedia. Neighbouring beaches in South Goa include Agonda Beach and Patnem Beach.

Planning a visit

For readers planning travel, Wikipedia lists the nearest airport as Dabolim Airport, around 67 km away. The nearest railway station is at Canacona, which can be reached from the major Madgaon junction railway station in about 30 minutes. There are bus services every half hour between Palolem Beach and the Kadamba Transport Corporation bus depot in Margao, and the nearest KTC depot is at Canacona, it says.

Wikipedia lists activities at the beach as swimming, fishing, parasailing and boat rides, and says lifeguards are on duty. It also says the beach attracts many international tourists mainly during the winter season between November and March — timing that is relevant now, as that season begins.

Tripadvisor's page suggests a visit duration of more than three hours, and its recent reviews, as read on the page, describe calm water, soft sand and sunsets, alongside beach shacks and cafes nearby. Reviewers' opinions are their own, and conditions on any given day can differ, so travellers should check local conditions on arrival.

Why it matters for Goa travel

For the diaspora, Goa is a frequent add-on to a family trip to India, and South Goa is often chosen for a quieter stay than the north. A ranking claim of this kind, made by the state government and reported nationally, puts one specific South Goa beach — not Goa in general — in the frame for that planning.

The useful next step is practical, not promotional: if Palolem is on an itinerary, use the Tripadvisor listing linked above to check recent traveller reviews, and use the location facts above — Canacona in South Goa, about 40 minutes from Margao, 67 km from Dabolim Airport — to judge whether it fits the rest of the trip. No booking price, availability or new facility is claimed in the sources read for this article, and none is stated here.
